steps.action: Narrowing a Global Field is refused in Edit while another module attaches it
steps.actual: With Contract type "NDA" also attaching it, saving Scope=Matter in Edit was refused: "Ind coverage region IND81T2F is attached outside the matter module — detach it there first, then narrow the scope.". The catalog still reads moduleScope=global.

steps.action: Narrowing succeeds after the other module detaches, and values are retained
steps.actual: After detaching the Contract-type attachment the same Edit save narrowed it to moduleScope=matter; Matter 24 still held "Nordics". Promoting it back in Edit returned moduleScope=global.
